exposure: Multifocal ventriculoperitoneal shunts with Y-connections (MVPS with Ys)
additional catheter inserted into the fourth ventricle
cohort: 33 consecutive patients who underwent initial conversion to multifocal ventriculoperitoneal shunts with Y-connections.
finding: The one-year overall shunt survival rate of MVPS with Y was 70%, similar to previously reported single VPSs, but the malfunction rate of the proximal catheter inserted at the fourth ventricle was higher than at other locations.
